title.narrative: Strengthening climate-smart agribusiness and natural resource management for adaptation and resilient livelihoods in Sudan#s White Nile, River Nile, and Northern States (SCAN- 3N)

description.narrative: This project in Sudan aims to enhance the climate resilience and adaptive capacity of vulnerable agro#pastoral communities in the White Nile, River Nile, and Northern States. By promoting Ecosystem#based Adaptation (EbA) approaches and climate#resilient green agribusiness models, the initiative seeks to address the challenges posed by climate change while improving livelihoods and food security. The project focuses on building the capacities of institutions, communities, and the private sector to adopt, scale up, and sustain EbA practices that support sustainable natural resource management. Through the integration of climate#smart techniques, sustainable land use, and inclusive green business opportunities, the project will empower local communities to reduce vulnerabilities, strengthen productive systems, and create sustainable economic pathways. Ultimately, this initiative contributes to improved resilience, enhanced food security, and the promotion of environmentally sound practices that safeguard ecosystems and foster long#term sustainable development across Sudan#s most climate#affected regions.
